Good Evening Mr. Ibrahim,

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused and truly appreciate your understanding.

Unfortunately, we are unable to assist with the extension as we have already received another confirmed booking, and the apartment is no longer available for the requested extension period.

Please kindly note that extensions are always subject to availability, and we are unable to hold or block an apartment without advance payment. We completely understand that this may be disappointing, and we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

Thank you once again for your kind understanding and cooperation.
